method: OpenCV 4.13.0; CLAHE (2.0,12x12), SIFT (16000 features, contrast .013, edge threshold 15), BF L2 ratio .72; deduplicate both source and destination 6px cells; deterministic held-out 60px source cells ((floor(x/60)+3*floor(y/60)) mod 5)==0; RANSAC 3 native px fit on remaining descriptor candidates. All holdout counts and unmatched residuals retained; RMS of consistent subset is conditional, not absolute accuracy. Cross-frame independent pairwise match RANSAC 2.5 photo px compares same landmarks in both registered frames; not physical survey.
limitations: Early-game state: zones 1-6 appear; later zones absent because not unlocked, not geographically absent. No existing zone, marker or coordinate changed.

Feature matching can include repeated structures or game icons; robust inliers and visual overlays are preliminary image calibration only. Held-out descriptors may contain false matches; conditional RMS must not be treated as whole-map accuracy.
No official sector outlines can be inferred from building shapes or label positions. No production boundary, route or exact pin approved.
